import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    if n <= 1:
        print(0)
        return
    result = 0
    consecutive = 1
    for j in range(n - 1):
        if s[j] == s[j + 1]:
            consecutive += 1
        else:
            if consecutive % 2 == 0:
                result += 1
            consecutive = 1
    if consecutive % 2 == 0:
        result += 1
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
